orchestrator.description: Prioritizes findings, reviews resolutions, decides next scan target

steps.label: Scan
steps.description: Scan the target area for issues. Write findings to context/. Update context/status.md.

steps.label: Triage
steps.description: Review scan results. Prioritize issues. Decide what to resolve this cycle. Update context/status.md.

steps.label: Resolve
steps.description: Fix prioritized issues. Commit changes. Update context/status.md.
